enter.title: Enter the code shown in the isshoni app
enter.label: Code

confirm.title: Link the isshoni app?
confirm.compare: Make sure it matches the code in the app.
confirm.nameHint: You can rename it later on your Devices page.
confirm.requestedSame: Requested {{when}} from {{ip}} (this browser's network). People on the same Wi-Fi or mobile carrier can share one address, so compare the code too.
confirm.different: This request came from a different network than this browser. Only continue if you started it yourself, for example on another computer or on mobile data.
confirm.unknown: isshoni couldn't check whether this request came from your network. Only continue if you started it yourself.
confirm.actsAs: The app will act as {{username}} on {{server}}: watch, share and change your settings.

name.too_long: That's too long for a name: 64 characters at most.
name.invalid: That name has characters that can't be used.

linked.title: Linked
linked.body: Go back to the app; it continues by itself.

denied.title: Not linked
denied.body: The app will show that you said no.

devices.empty: Nothing is linked yet. When you link the isshoni app to this account, it shows up here.
devices.removeBody: {{name}} will be signed out and has to be linked again.
devices.removeBodyCurrent: This app will be signed out.
